title: SEC1: take_vars type change silently abandons lifetime discipline
description:
In commit 08810bf, take_vars/restore_vars changed from Vec<(&'static str, Option<String>)> to Vec<(String, Option<String>)>.

ISSUE: The old code explicitly used Box::leak() to convert name literals into &'static str, making test-only memory leaks intentional and visible. The new version silently allocates heap Strings for every env var name in the test suite (~80+ allocations per test run).

BURDEN: A future maintainer reading 'Vec<(String, ...)>' will assume it's normal data, not realizing Strings are leaked. The explicit Box::leak() was self-documenting.

RECOMMENDATION: Either revert to &'static str with Box::leak(), or add a comment explaining the intentional leak pattern.

FILE: crates/kithd/src/config.rs:190–209
CONTEXT: Tests use [#serial] to prevent concurrent env mutation; leak is safe and intentional.
